entries.en: Where's the guard?
Kill her.
I've seen you.
I cannot go on. You will have to stop him, Shepard.
No. He is still in my mind. I am not entirely myself. I never will be again.
Hm. I suppose that is how history will know me.
I still hear it. Like metal on metal. Squealing and reverberating.
Mother...
Good night, Little Wing. I will see you again with the dawn.
No light? They always said there would be-- Ah...
This is not over. Saren is unstoppable. My mind is filled with his light. Everything is clear.
I will not betray him. You will-- You...
You must listen. Saren still whispers in my mind. I can fight his compulsions. Briefly. But the indoctrination is strong.
It is a terror to be trapped in your mind. To beat upon the glass as your hands torture and murder. I was powerless; nothing but a tool for Saren.
People are not themselves around Saren. You come to idolize him. Worship him. You would do anything for him.
He sent me here to find the location of the Mu Relay. Its position was lost thousands of years ago.
You do not know the privilege of being a mother. There is power in creation. To shape a life. Turn it toward happiness or despair.
Have you faced an asari commando unit before? Few humans have.
I think not.
Your insolence is a poor mask for your fear.
I won't be moved by sympathy. No matter who you bring into this confrontation.
Indeed? What have you told him about me, Liara?
Indeed? What have you told her about me, Liara?
What could I say, mother? That you're insane? Evil? Should I explain how to kill you? What could I say?
Hold on. We've got medi-gel, maybe we can--
First you turn on the Council, now on Saren. You're not loyal to anything, are you?
You're free of the "indoctrination" again?
The rachni didn't cooperate with you. Why should I?
I expected better from asari commandos.
Start talking, Benezia. What's Saren's next move?
We met Shiala on Feros. She told us about Sovereign's indoctrination.
You chose to join with Saren. You just got more than you bargained for.
Are you saying he brainwashed you?
How can he compel you? He's not even here.
We don't have to fight. You can return to the Citadel with us.
You won't look so smug with a hole in your head.
Liara's here because she's a member of my crew.
I have no idea what you're talking about, and I don't care.
Stay with us.
Treacherous words.
You all there?
The rachni seem to disagree.
Your troops are sloppy.
What is Saren planning?
Like the asari on Feros.
Quit making excuses.
Indoctrination?
Saren's controlling you?
Surrender.
You can't take me.
The key is Sovereign, his flagship. It is a dreadnought of incredible size and its power is extraordinary.
I cannot say. The geth did not build it. Its technology is far more advanced than that of any known species.
It has a very powerful mass effect drive. But that is not Sovereign's true power.
Thoughts echo strangely within Sovereign. Its rooms are built at unsettling angles.
The longer you stay aboard, the more Saren's will seems correct. You sit at his feet and smile as his words pour into you.
You have to stop-- me. I can't-- His teeth are at my ear. Fingers on my spine. You should-- Uh, you should--
Mother, I-- Don't leave! Fight him!
You've always made me proud, Liara.
--Die!
Her children were to be ours. Raised to hunt and slay Saren's enemies.
Sovereign's not like other ships. Where did it come from?
The ship that attacked Eden Prime? I didn't think anything that size could land on a planet.
Where did he get it?
It attacked Eden Prime.
I sealed a part of my mind away from the indoctrination. Saving it for a moment when I could help destroy him. It will not last long.
Why are you able to break free of his control now?
Why should I believe you?
I now realize I should have been stricter with her.
I can't believe you'd kill your own daughter.
There's obviously no peaceful way to settle this.
What about Liara?
I guess you won't negotiate.
Four thousand years ago, a star nearby went supernova. The shockwave propelled the relay out of its system, but did not damage it.
Its precise vector and speed are impossible to determine. As millennia passed, the nebula created by the nova enveloped the relay.
It is difficult to find any cold object in interstellar space. Particularly something swathed in hot dust and radiation.
Two thousand years ago, the rachni inhabited that region of our galaxy. They discovered the relay.
The rachni can share memories across generations. Queens inherit the knowledge of their mothers.
I took the location of the relay from the queen's mind. I was not gentle.
I was not myself, but-- I should have been stronger.
He believes it will lead him to the Conduit. I would tell you more if I could, but Saren did not share his counsel with me. I was merely a servant to his cause.
They searched, patiently. They are territorial creatures, driven to close any possible way into their systems.
I transcribed the data to an OSD. Take it. Please.
Knowing the relay's coordinates isn't enough. We need to know where to go from there.
Knowing the relay's coordinates is not enough. Do you know where he planned to go from there?
Knowing the relay's location isn't enough. We need to know where to go from there.
Saren wouldn't tell me his destination. But you must find out quickly. I transmitted the coordinates to him before you arrived.
Someone on Noveria found it?
How does something that big go missing?
Can I assume you found the coordinates?
You can still make it right. Give me the information.
Tell me where the Mu gate is before I lose my temper.
Why does Saren need the Mu relay?
How did the rachni find it?
You have to give me the location.
You're here for that?
How do you lose a relay?
You have it?
You regret your actions.
Saren's plan
Rachni found relay
I need that information.
Yes. But it would not be my will, Shepard.
So you could turn on me again.
You might attack again?
It is subtle at first. I thought I was strong enough to resist. Instead, I became a willing tool, eager to serve.
Liara's here because she wants to be. Not because I asked her to.
That's not why Liara's here.
He sent me here to find the Mu Relay. He believes it will lead him to Ilos and the Conduit.
There isn't much time. I transmitted the coordinates to Saren before you arrived.
Shepard. I am myself again.
This is not the end! I will not--
This one. Serves as our voice. We cannot sing. Not in these low spaces. Your musics are colorless.
This vessel is at the edge. Yet she struggles. You cannot see her magnificence. We are breathing on the embers.
Your way of communicating is strange. Flat. It does not color the air. When we speak, one moves all.
This is going to be a fun conversation.
We are the mother. We sing for those left behind. The children you thought silenced.
Our kind sing through touchings of thought. We pluck the strings, and the other understands. She is weak to urging.
She has colors we have no names for. But she is ending. Her music is bittersweet. It is beautiful.
No. We were locked away here. The children are beyond our songs. They have been lost to silence.
You are not in harmony with those who hoped to control us.
There are acid tanks rigged up on that thing. Set them off. Millions of my ancestors died to put these things down. Don't let them come back.
Commander, I don't trust this thing. We know its kind are killers. The tank is rigged with acid. I recommend using it.
The rachni were a threat to the galaxy. Those tanks are filled with acid. If she gets out of hand, they dissolve her.
Look. Those tanks? Acid. Strong enough to kill anything, no matter its biology. They wouldn't have installed that if they weren't afraid of the consequences of her getting loose.
Commander. Those tanks on her enclosure? They're acid. Strong enough to dissolve any living creature. They must have installed them for a reason.
They made a mistake. They let the krogan go too far. This is a chance for us to atone. She has done nothing to us.
Commander, there's some old grudges in the galaxy. Grudges humans should stay out of. If we kill her, we kill the entire race.
She's the last of her race, Commander. We don't have the objectivity to judge her.
If you kill her, you consign an entire race to death. We should let the Citadel Council decide her fate.
We'd be making a whole race extinct. I don't want that on my conscience when I go to the final judgment.
Your companions hear the truth. You have the power to free us, or return our people to the silence of memory.
We do not know. We were only an egg, hearing Mother cry in our dreams.
A tone from space hushed one voice after another. It forced the singers to resonate with its own sour yellow note.
Then we awoke, in this place. The last echo of those who came out from the Singing Planet. The sky is silent.
No. We-- I do not know what happened in the war. We only heard discordance, songs the color of oily shadows.
We would seek a hidden place to teach our children harmony. If they understand, perhaps we would return.
Are you stupid? Your people didn't fight these bastards, so maybe you don't get it!
There's a reason their kind were hunted to extinction. It's better to be safe than let a dangerous race loose.
Do what you want. My people will clean up this mess later. Just like we did for the salarians.
If this had happened in Tokyo, or Armstrong, or on the Citadel, the death toll would be...
If you can trust them to stay there.
I don't want to trust the safety of my little sisters to this... alien. It's better to be sure.
You will give us the chance to compose anew? We will remember. We will sing of your forgiveness to our children.
Great. Bugs are writing songs about you. Mark my words. You'll regret this.
No! Stop feeling and think. Even if you disagree with asari morals, you must see she could be an ally.
What's the matter? Are the asari looking for a new species to cuddle up with?
We can't exterminate them. Not without the Council's approval. Genocide is one of the reasons we fought the krogan-- ah...
You want to learn about genocide, Vakarian? I'll take you to a krogan obstetrician's office.
Commander. Genocide is way beyond the scope of our mandate here.
Is our kind so frightening? You would seek our silence if you cannot muffle our songs? If you cannot have us as your obedient claws?
